input: Internal memo from the move team. Going forward, in order to facilitate a seamless relocation, all stakeholders are kindly requested to utilise the crates provided and action the packing of personal items prior to the close of business on the last day at Station Road. IT will leverage its own resources for hardware. Further details re desks, badges and the commencement date at the new premises will be communicated in due course.
output:
Office move: Station Road to Riverside House

We are moving to Riverside House, 14 Canal Street. Our last day at Station Road is Wednesday 2 December 2026. The office closes at 16:00. Our first day at Riverside House is Monday 7 December 2026.

What you need to do:
- Pack your personal items in your two crates by 16:00 on Wednesday 2 December.
- Label each crate with your name and your team's zone.
- Do not pack monitors, docking stations or keyboards. IT will move them.
- Take your laptop and charger home on Wednesday 2 December.
- Book a desk in the DeskBook app. Booking opens on Monday 30 November.
- Collect your new badge at reception from 08:00 on Monday 7 December. Bring photo ID.

Questions? Email the move team at move-team@example.com.
